# Independent constructor-witness verifier audit

CLEAN/ACCEPT. I read all of `term_circuits.py`, `circuit-note.md`, the arena/path denotation argument in `note.md`, the trusted source50 specification and actual live Code254 constructors/rules. All11 fixed definition ASTs agree exactly between live Code254 and the trusted specification. I also checked every trusted circuit's register references point to parameters, zero or earlier instructions. No submitted suite or Lean/Coq build was repeated; no source was edited. Exact sources/hashes and counts are in `circuit-independent-review.json`.

Soundness with duplicates is valid. Backward references make the arena acyclic; forbidding only positive `B0(0,0)` still makes ID0 the sole zero-valued node, by induction and Cantor positivity. Arbitrary positive duplicates therefore cannot forge a zero alias. Each supplied constructor record establishes the intended numeric constructor, including the dynamic all-zero implication case. Static sharing occurs only in trusted fixed symbolic templates and imposes no global candidate-arena uniqueness assumption.

Both bundle witnesses are necessary and checked. Traversed prefixes have equal nonzero tags; the endpoint has a zero/nonzero or tag mismatch. Cantor injectivity propagates that inequality to the original roots. Equal-valued but pointer-distinct duplicate terms cannot pass either path gate. Overlong paths encountering an earlier mismatch are rejected, which affects completeness of that encoding only; genuine inequalities always have a finite shortest distinguishing path.

Truth, direct MP and GEN match the exact numeric calculus. MP checks the major record against the minor and proposed output, preserving premise order and allowing the legitimate all-zero alias. IDs are used only as sufficient equality, so different but equal-valued premise copies can be rejected without threatening soundness. Every exact `B1(0,0)` copy denotes1, so the default endpoint correctly accepts any such copy. A certificate cannot select its goal or templates; the optional goal and compiled fixed theory data are explicitly trusted caller inputs.

Existential completeness is justified by the canonical source50 producer: its arena contains every required constructor intermediate, all equalities use consistent IDs, zero aliases use0, and each valid bundle has both finite paths. The checker need not accept every duplicate-containing presentation of a valid derivation. There are5,6,5,5,5,6,5,6 instructions for rho1–8 and62 for the full bundle, matching the note; these are interface counts, not machine states.

The source and note correctly leave binary parsing/serialization, random-access implementation, circuit selection, failure/reset protocol, fair enumeration, blank initialization, total state cost and formal simulation open. This audit covers neither the separately developed codec nor any PA/ZFC calibration theorem.

# Independent finite-codec and search audit

The mathematical/source review is CLEAN. I read all of `term_codec.py`, `codec-note.md` and the stored test source, using the preceding independent circuit audit. No full suite or Lean/Coq build was repeated. One narrow exception-policy mismatch was found, corrected by the author and independently rechecked as described below.

For every finite binary string, the parser advances its cursor at every unary/path step or rejects at EOF. Node/row loops use finite parsed counts with4N/5P minimum remaining-bit checks before per-record allocation, and all other field loops have trusted fixed arity. The parser never unfolds arena terms or delegates a variable-length recursive parse. All candidate addresses are explicitly bounded. This is total as an ordinary finite algorithm under the stated unbounded-resource interpretation and fixed valid template tables.

The structural encoder domain is precise: only the three fixed outer fields and tag-specific exact row fields, sole zero node, locally valid backward references, tags/arity and witness lists. It intentionally includes false proof rows and false gate witnesses. The decoder produces that domain. Unique unary/fixed-width/path encodings, known counts/arity and mandatory EOF establish both roundtrips by finite record induction. Empty proof lists parse but fail the logical verifier. A constructor certificate admitted by the earlier flexible verifier but carrying extra object fields need not belong to this stricter encoding domain; existential completeness only needs the canonical producer's ordinary finite encodings.

No word can select a goal, template family or version. `accepts` uses only the default fixedF verifier. Thus the earlier circuit soundness/completeness argument transfers to existence of an accepted finite word. Length-lex enumeration visits every word once at rank `2^L-1+value(word)`; each earlier check terminates mathematically, so semidecide is fair. Bounded search is separately named and labels its no-hit result by the finite length bound. The code never infers consistency from a completed level or resource failure.

The note correctly does not carry the former O(L²) bit bound through unary addresses, and charges no fictitious machine-state saving. Parsing, indexed access, fixed data, workspace/reset, blank startup, whole compiler cost and formal simulation are still future implementation obligations.

The sole issue was literal exception policy: the original `term_circuits.verify_certificate` caught `RecursionError`, while codec prose said resource errors propagate. An injected constructor exception on a structurally valid GEN control was converted toFalse; the independent probe is preserved in `codec-resource-boundary-probe.json`. This was a runtime-boundary mismatch, not an accepted false proof or a failure of the ordinary unbounded-resource theorem. Fibers removed that catch and added explicit MemoryError/RecursionError probes inside the actual constructor call. I independently verified that the entire source delta is just removal of RecursionError from the catch tuple (reconstructing the original reproduces its exact audited hash), and both resource errors now propagate through codec→verifier while the valid GEN control remains valid. Publication source/test copies are byte-identical. The author's fresh portable replay passed at `/tmp/zfc-term-maintained-replay-corrected/verification.json`; no full suite was repeated by me. The companion JSON records original and corrected hashes and this evidence.
